story.fullStory:
Bob Seger's "Night Moves" reached #4 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Night Moves" is a song by American singer-songwriter Bob Seger.

It was the lead single from his ninth studio album of the same name (1976), which was released on Capitol Records.

Seger wrote the song as a coming of age tale about adolescent love and adult memory of it.

The song peaked at #4 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 21 weeks on the chart.

Robert Clark Seger ( SEE-gər; born May 6, 1945) is an American retired singer, songwriter, and musician.
A roots rock musician known for his raspy, powerful voice, Seger is one of the best-known artists of the heartland rock genre, with his songs often concerning love, women, and blue-collar themes.
